name: Downloads stack
author: Vasiliy Kirochka
description: A macOS-style stack of your most recent downloads in the Omarchy bar. Click to fan them out, drag any file straight into another app, or open the folder.

barWidget.description: One bar icon showing your latest download with a badge for new files. Left = open the stack, right = open the folder, middle = mark everything seen. Drag a file out of the stack into any app.

schema.label: Folder to watch
schema.description: Absolute path. Empty means the XDG download directory (usually ~/Downloads).

schema.label: Stack layout
schema.description: Grid shows thumbnails; list shows one file per row with its kind and size.

schema.label: Bar badge
schema.description: `new` counts files added since you last opened the stack, `count` shows the whole folder, `none` hides the badge.

schema.label: Close the stack after a drag
File manager
schema.description: Used to reveal a single file. `nautilus` selects the file; anything else falls back to opening the folder with xdg-open.
